Action Construction Equipment Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Action Construction Equipment Limited announced the approval of its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on November 12, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 88,352 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 16,297 lakhs. Basic earnings per share stood at Rs. 13.70. Consolidated revenue from operations for the same quarter was Rs. 88,609 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 16,425 lakhs. Consolidated basic earnings per share was Rs. 13.80. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 1,66,520 lakhs, and profit after tax was Rs. 28,156 lakhs. Consolidated revenue from operations was Rs. 1,67,177 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 28,374 lakhs. The limited review reports of the auditors are enclosed with the announcement.
